body_html:
Elearning 1.0 and 2.0 by @downes Stephen Downes

This was a great overview. Though I do not think #LinkedData is the great savior of elearning. I think we were doing this stuff in plain old semantic HTML for a long time. I believe this is still a great way forward. Have no problem with JSON-LD, but Web 1.0, Web 2.0...plenty of us were doing this online

We just allowed power to be centralized. Time to take it back.

Knowldge as pattern recognition rings true to my more situativist tendancies.
